source.title: Consumer Expenditure Surveys: quintiles of income before taxes, annual means, 2024
source.table: public API v1 series CXUFOODAWAYLB0101M to LB0106M, CXUTOTALEXPLB0101M to LB0106M, CXUINCBEFTXLB0101M to LB0106M, year 2024 (the 2025 annual was not yet published)

rows.officialClass: CE item: Food away from home
rows.unit: USD per year per consumer unit
rows.measure: average annual spending on food away from home, all consumer units, 2024
rows.note: Food away from home: meals and snacks at restaurants, cafes, fast food, vending and on trips; a consumer unit is roughly a household.
